mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info ( nickname, email, pwd, translate_code, user_status ) VALUES ( #{nickname}, #{email}, #{pwd}, #{translateCode}, #{userStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_seq u.email, u.nickname, u.use_yn, u.translate_code, u.user_status, u.reg_dt, u.mod_dt FROM user_info u WHERE u.email = #{email}
